errors.text_span: Die Balken illustrieren den Saldo, beginnend bei ca. -50, variierend zwischen negativen und positiven Werten und endend bei ca. -150.
errors.evidence: The saldo is shown as blue vertical bars on the right scale, but the description does not specify the correct visual style clearly enough and implies they 'vary between negative and positive values'; in the chart the bars are consistently negative across most of the period and do not become positive.
The saldo bars start closer to about -10 to -20 on the right axis, not -50.
The final saldo bars are around -160 to -170 on the right axis, so -150 is somewhat off.
The description omits the marker/line style details requested by the prompt (e.g., the lines are solid and there are vertical bars for saldo; no marker shapes are present).
The description does not mention the x-axis tick interval in detail beyond monthly subdivision, nor does it state the scale type explicitly as linear.
